notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
We have received a lot of feedback since the game was released last month. we appreciate the comments from you guys. In this patch, we update the following contents:

- Much more accurate shield activation. 
- Better shooting battle gameplay experience. 
- Boss battle is less difficult.

We wish you enjoy the game!

notes.title: The Stone FAQ
notes.content:
Welcome to The Stone Steam FAQ!  Please read through to see if your question has been answered before posting it to the forums: 

[b]SETTING UP[/b]

[b]1. What can I expect from The Stone?[/b]

The Stone is a full-feature VR game that integrates movie story narrative, VR game style and RPG/FPS game design concept to represent a high quality movie style RPG game for you.

[b]2. What specs should my PC have to run The Stone?[/b]

Minimum specs:
OS: Windows 7 SP1 - 64 bit, Windows 8.1 - 64 bit, Windows 10 - 64 bit
Processor: Intel i5-4590/ AMD FX 8350 equivalent or greater
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon™ RX 480 equivalent or greater
Storage: 3 GB available space
Additional Notes: VR Headset required (HTC VIVE or Oculus)

[b]3. Do I need to have VR headset to play this game?[/b]

The Stone was built exclusively for VR and it exclusively available for VR, so you do need a VR headset to play this game.

[b]4. Which languages are supported in-game?[/b]

Apart from the current English in-game language, we will soon update the game to include other  languages.

[b]5. How much space do I need to play The Stone?[/b]

You only need to meet the minimum space requirement of HTC Vive or Oculus to run this game. In the game, you can teleport from one spot to another. 

[b]6. Which VR HMDs and peripherals does The Stone currently support?[/b]

Supported HMDs:
- HTC VIVE HMDs with Vive controllers 
- Oculus Rift consumer HMDs with Oculus Touch controllers

[b]7. In the process of gaming, what is wrong when frame drops or shows white screen?[/b]

Please check out your computer if it is meet the minimum hardware requirement to run The Stone, and then check out the connection of HMD.  If the weather is too hot, it will also cause frame loss. Please try to cool your HDM.  We will continue to update our game to improve picture quality and fix bugs, give you the best game experience. 

[b]BUG REPORTS & TECHNICAL SUPPORT[/b]

[b]1. Where should I go to receive personal support?[/b]

If you are encountering bugs or technical issues, please contact [u]thestone@bornteks.com[/u] and supply us with a description of the problem and your system specs. 

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

[b]1. Will/Does The Stone have online multiplayer? [/b]

Currently, The Stone has not the multiplayer mode, but we are planning to develop the multiplayer mode in our future update. 

[b]2. Will The Stone have follow-up Story?[/b]

We can definitely confirm that The Stone will have follow-up Story, we are working on it. If you are interested in our game and hope to give some suggestions about the follow-up story , please email us at thestone@bornteks.com. If your suggestion was adopted, your name would show up on the official list of game producers. 

[b]3. Will The Stone have acchivement system?[/b]

In the first release version, it has not the achievement system, but we will add it to our game soon. 

[b]4. How to choose and click on the menu of The Stone?[/b]

Please nod your head to choose and pull the trigger to click. 

[b]5.How to use the pause menu? [/b]

In the process of gaming, players can click on the menu to pause the game. The menu function is forbidden on the following situation:
- in the middle of scene switch, and scene fade in or out. 
- in the middle of conversation with a NPC.
- ACT1: Jake’s decision & Mission Silence

[b]6. How to move in the game. [/b]

Player will have blink ability in the game after the first three scene. In the game, it will not require player to move in long distance. 

[b]7. Will The Stone have more weapons and enemies in future update?[/b]

Yes, we will add more fight modes and more enemies. Player will learn more skills to accomplish these new challenges.

[b]8. Will I be able to choose difficuities? [/b]

We will add difficulty options in future update. If you have any suggestions, please post on the forum or email us at [u]thestone@bornteks.com[/u].
